title: Structure basis for recognition of plant Rpn10 by phytoplasma SAP05 in ubiquitin-independent protein degradation.
authors: Zhang, Liying; Du, Yunxiang; Qu, Qian; Zheng, Qingyun
one_liner_zh: 该研究解析了植原体效应蛋白SAP05与植物蛋白酶体亚基Rpn10复合物的晶体结构，揭示其通过分子胶机制介导转录因子GATA/SPL的泛素非依赖性降解，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关转录因子但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作，结构生物学方法可借鉴于TF-DNA复合物建模。
abstract: Besides traditional ubiquitin-dependent proteasome degradation, thousands of eukaryotic proteins more than previously appreciated could undergo ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation (UbInPD). A pathogen-encoded effector protein SAP05 secreted by phytoplasma, could hijack hostage Rpn10 subunit of proteasome derived from Arabidopsis thaliana and target the degradation of GATA BINDING FACTOR (GATA) or SQUAMOSA-PROMOTER BINDING PROTEIN-LIKE (SPL) transcription factors (TFs) without ubiquitin or additional proteasome shuttle factors. To explain how could SAP05 target the degradation bypassing the ubiquitin-dependent pathway, we have determined the crystal structure of the complex between Arabidopsis thaliana Rpn10 and Aster Yellows witches'-broom phytoplasma SAP05 or onion yellow phytoplasma SAP05, which showed a previously unknown recognition interface. Sequence alignment and structural biological evidence showed that this interaction is highly conserved in various SAP05 homologs, suggesting a general mode in plant infection. After docking the complex structure to the plant proteasome, SAP05 was near to the adenosine triphosphatase (ATPase) central pore and enough to submit substrate to degradation process, which suggested a molecular glue-like role to bridge TFs close to the ATPase central pore of proteasomes for the direct degradation.
abstract_zh: 除了传统的依赖泛素的蛋白酶体降解途径外，数千种真核生物蛋白质比以往认知的更多，可能经历不依赖泛素的蛋白酶体降解（UbInPD）。一种由植原体分泌的病原体编码效应蛋白SAP05，能够劫持来自拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）蛋白酶体的Rpn10亚基作为“人质”，并在无泛素或额外蛋白酶体穿梭因子的情况下，靶向降解GATA结合因子（GATA）或SQUAMOSA-启动子结合蛋白样（SPL）转录因子（TFs）。为了解释SAP05如何绕过依赖泛素的途径靶向降解，我们解析了拟南芥Rpn10与翠菊黄化病植原体SAP05或洋葱黄化病植原体SAP05复合物的晶体结构，该结构展示了一个此前未知的识别界面。序列比对和结构生物学证据表明，这种相互作用在各种SAP05同源物中高度保守，提示其在植物感染中具有普遍模式。将复合物结构对接至植物蛋白酶体后，SAP05位于三磷酸腺苷酶（ATPase）中央孔附近，足以将底物提交至降解过程，这表明其发挥类似分子胶的作用，将转录因子桥接至蛋白酶体ATPase中央孔附近以进行直接降解。
